title: 2020 HMMT November Guts Problem 27
statement: In \(\triangle A B C, D\) and \(E\) are the midpoints of \(B C\) and \(C A\), respectively. \(A D\) and \(B E\) intersect at \(G\). Given that \(G E C D\) is cyclic, \(A B=41\), and \(A C=31\), compute \(B C\).

solutions.text:
By Power of a Point,

\[\frac{2}{3} A D^{2}=A D \cdot A G=A E \cdot A C=\frac{1}{2} \cdot 31^{2}\]

so \(A D^{2}=\frac{3}{4} \cdot 31^{2}\). The median length formula yields

\[A D^{2}=\frac{1}{4}\left(2 A B^{2}+2 A C^{2}-B C^{2}\right)\]

whence

\[B C=\sqrt{2 A B^{2}+2 A C^{2}-4 A D^{2}}=\sqrt{2 \cdot 41^{2}+2 \cdot 31^{2}-3 \cdot 31^{2}}=49\]
